This is Worldline.
 We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. The solutions our people build today power the growth of millions of businesses tomorrow. From your local coffee shop to unicorns and international banks. From San Francisco to Auckland. We are in every corner of the world, in every part of commerce. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity
 This role is part of the Digital Services unit, within the Identity Trust & Authentication entity. The team designs, develops and hosts multichannel e-commerce payment and authentication applications for major French and international accounts.
The position supports the modernization of our Cloud Wallet product and its technical infrastructure. You will join the Delivery Benelux squad to design, build and operate a microservice on Google Cloud that lets end users explore raw data and derive statistical insights that banks use to monitor their activity day to day.
 Day-to-day Responsibilities
Analyze and understand business needs
Study and propose technical solutions
Contribute to the development and deployment of the microservice within the Delivery Benelux squad
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, deployment and testing
Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform, and package applications with Docker and Helm
Operate workloads on OpenShift / Kubernetes and Google Cloud, and contribute to monitoring and reliability
Work within a complete product roadmap and a large-scale Agile organization
Write technical documentation
 Tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Docker, Terraform, Helm, Google Cloud Platform, OpenShift Tools: JIRA, IntelliJ IDEA, GitLab, Confluence
 Who Are We Looking For
2 to 4 years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering or software development with strong DevOps practices
Hands-on experience with Docker, Terraform, Helm and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred)
Experience with Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider
Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot; Angular is a plus
Understanding of deployment and test automation and the challenges of CI/CD
Experience working in an Agile environment
Professional English, written and spoken
Ability to drive positive change, share knowledge and work well in a team, with a passion for learning and progress
 Perks & Benefits
 If you join us, you will enjoy:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Free private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
